usedFor: Microsoft Dynamics CRM holds leads and contacts, and Zoom signs them up for a webinar with “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A new lead is the right person to invite, and the action registers them for the session directly.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM is polling, so registration follows a scheduled check, not instantly.
